arguments.config:
# The CircleCI docs "Using matrix jobs" example: it calls node/install from
# the circleci/node orb, which kumitate never fetches.
version: 2.1
orbs:
  node: circleci/node@4.7
executors:
  docker:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:stable
  linux:
    machine:
      image: ubuntu-2404:current
  macos:
    macos:
      xcode: 27.1.0
jobs:
  test:
    parameters:
      os:
        type: executor
      node-version:
        type: string
    executor: << parameters.os >>
    steps:
      - checkout
      - node/install:
          node-version: << parameters.node-version >>
          install-yarn: true
workflows:
  all-tests:
    jobs:
      - test:
          matrix:
            parameters:
              os: [docker, linux, macos]
              node-version: ["14.17.6", "16.9.0"]
